manual_review: Only production file changed is smc_mixer.c. Fader target function and specialized clip/editor ownership are preserved.

HOME/MIX PARTS K1-5 pan, K6 decay, K7 feedback, K8 resonance. Drum knobs look up Pan by exact kit/voice/bank, with missing tails inactive. Ordinary rows are checked against every active fader, including cross-strip conflicts.
GLOBAL/PERFORM K3 and MIX/MASTER K4 override only their DJF duplicates. No DSP, channel/button/transport or acceleration changes.

Duplicate absolute samples still maintain normal pickup crossing/write semantics, but cannot open/extend the overlay. First sample after a real connection is admitted; no physical-device packet origin inferred.
Existing1200ms timeout and underlying UI state retained. Navigation and target refresh remain silent.
Rendering uses existing fonts/framebuffer and bounded stack buffers, without new dynamic allocation. Inspected real final frames for pickup, ACTIVE, pan, drum-bank, action, clip and parked row.
